name: hud_stack_refusals_said
description: A call for the next wave that the simulation would not take is refused before it goes out, and the screen says why (M8, design 2.7 and 5.7): while a partner is back from the caretaker and waits for the next window to be handed back ('Seat 2 takes the seat back at the next window'), with three waves on the road ('Three waves are on the road') and during the last wave ('Wave 12 is the last'); each press says it in the notice with the error sound, asks no second press and sends nothing, and the horn greys with the words in its tooltip. Taking a call back is one press. With company a call waits for the partner, and the horn sounds as the partner's lands. A READY the simulation refuses NO_STACK (sent past the controller, as an order on its way when the road filled would land) says why too: the notice is cleared first, so only the refusal can put the words back.

steps.assert: Game.stack_refusal() == 'Seat 2 takes the seat back at the next window' and node('Ready').disabled
steps.msg: a partner back from the caretaker needs a window: no call, and the horn greys

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'Seat 2 takes the seat back at the next window' and not scene.controller.call_armed()
steps.msg: the press says why and asks for no second press

steps.assert: node('TooltipBody').text == 'Seat 2 takes the seat back at the next window.'
steps.msg: the horn's tooltip says it too
taking a call back is one press
with company my call waits for the partner

steps.assert: Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([2, 3, 4]) and not Game.is_ready() and node('Ready').disabled
steps.msg: both called twice: three waves on the road, every Ready cleared, the horn greyed

steps.assert: Game.stack_refusal() == 'Three waves are on the road'
node('Notice').text == 'Three waves are on the road' and not scene.controller.call_armed()
steps.msg: a fourth is refused before it goes out, with why

steps.assert: node('TooltipBody').text == 'Three waves are on the road.'

steps.msg: the notice is clear before the order goes out

steps.assert: seq > 0 and not Game.is_ready() and node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'Three waves are on the road' and Game.refusal_text(16) == 'Three waves are on the road'
steps.msg: a READY the simulation refuses NO_STACK says why

steps.assert: Game.state == 1 and Game.stack_refusal() == 'Wave 12 is the last' and node('Ready').disabled
steps.msg: in the last wave nothing is left to call

steps.assert: node('Notice').text == 'Wave 12 is the last' and not scene.controller.call_armed()
